description:
Port cert.Verify (in cert/cert.go) to TypeScript. New module clients/typescript/src/cert.ts.

Verification steps (must match Go semantics exactly — the Go test suite in cert/cert_test.go and cert/revocation_test.go is the cross-language contract):

1. Ed25519.verify(masterPub, Cert.content, Cert.signature). Fail = ErrUnauthorized.
2. Decode SignedCertContent from Cert.content.
3. Check workspace_id == expected. Mismatch = reject (defense in depth, see cert.proto comments).
4. Check now is in [not_before, not_after]. Outside = reject. Use the same time source as the rest of the client (caller-injectable for tests).
5. Check serial NOT in revoked set. Present = reject.
6. Return a Claim { agent_id, peer_pubkey, label, caps_bits, serial, workspace_id } for the caller to use.

Caps mapping: bit 1 = Owner, 2 = Write, 4 = Resize. Owner implies Write + Resize at the consumer layer (see claimToIdentity in auth/cert.go).

Revocation set: caller passes initial Set<string>; expose an updateRevoked(set) method for runtime updates. No SIGHUP equivalent in the browser.

Depends on the Ed25519 lib choice (parent epic ship-3pp) and the protobuf decode for SignedCertContent (ship-3pp.2).
title: TS client: cert verification
